newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Congress may get telecom bill this wk.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Congress may get telecom bill this wk.

text.p: A bill creating Brazil's new General Telecommunications Law is likely to go to Congress' lower house this week but no specific date has been set yet, a Communications Ministry spokesman said.
"Stay tuned. It will probably go this week," said the spokesman.
He said no date has been set for sending the bill to the Chamber of Deputies, where it would get a first reading by the science and technology commission.
If approved by the panel, the bill would then go to the chamber's full floor. It also needs Senate approval before it can be signed into law.

The bill would create a comprehensive law for Brazil's telecom sector, establishing a regulatory watchdog, conventional phone service regulations and rules outlining the transfer of the federal Telebras system to private hands.
Market analysts said investors and others interested in the giant Brazilian telecom sector will be closely following the measure's progress.
